resolved.title: 变量类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Specifying the data type is required just once, at the time when the variable is declared.
After that, the variable may be used without referring to the data type. [code format="cpp" ][b]int [/b]a;
a = 10;[/code]
[note]Specifying the data type for a given variable more than once results in a syntax error.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Specifying the data type is required just once, at the time when the variable is declared.
After that, the variable may be used without referring to the data type. [code format="cpp" ][b]int [/b]a;
a = 10;[/code]
[note]Specifying the data type for a given variable more than once results in a syntax error.[/note]

content.text:
在声明变量的时候，指定变量类型**只需要一次**。

此后，则可直接使用该变量，并且进行赋值，无需再次指定变量类型。
content.text_html:
Specifying the data type is required just once, at the time when the variable is declared. After that, the variable may be used without referring to the data type.

指定数据类型只需要一次，在声明变量的时候。 此后，可以在不参考数据类型的情况下使用该变量。

content.text: 当给一个变量指定类型超过一次后，会导致语法错误。
content.text_html:
Specifying the data type for a given variable more than once results in a syntax error.

为一个给定的变量指定数据类型超过一次会导致语法错误。

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A variable's value may be changed as many times as necessary throughout the program.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" codeId="181"]int a = 100;
[b]a = 50;[/b]
cout << a;
[/code]
[note]Run the code and see how it works![/note]

resolved.title: auto 关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]auto Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The [b]auto[/b] keyword allows you to [b]automatically[/b] deduct the type of the variable being declared. It infers the data type of the variable from its value.

[s0l0!-header]For example:[/s0l0!-header][code format="cpp" ]    auto x = 4; //integer
    auto y = 3.37; //float
    auto z = "hello"; //string [/code]
[note]Any variable declared with the auto keyword should be initialized [b]at the time of its declaration[/b] or there will be an error.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]auto Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The [b]auto[/b] keyword allows you to [b]automatically[/b] deduct the type of the variable being declared. It infers the data type of the variable from its value.

[s0l0!-header]For example:[/s0l0!-header][code format="cpp" ]    auto x = 4; //integer
    auto y = 3.37; //float
    auto z = "hello"; //string [/code]
[note]Any variable declared with the auto keyword should be initialized [b]at the time of its declaration[/b] or there will be an error.[/note]

content.text:
**auto**关键字允许你在声明且初始化变量时，不显示指定变量的类型，而是从初始化变量的值中推断出该变量的类型。

**例如**:
content.text_html:
The auto keyword allows you to automatically deduct the type of the variable being declared. It infers the data type of the variable from its value.

For example:

自动关键字允许你**自动地扣除被声明的变量的类型。它从变量的值中推断出它的数据类型。

＃＃＃例如。

content.short_content:
auto x = 4; // 整数
    auto y = 3.37; // 浮点数
    auto z = "hello"; // 字符串
content.content:
auto x = 4; // 整数
    auto y = 3.37; // 浮点数
    auto z = "hello"; // 字符串

content.text: 任何用**auto**关键字声明的变量都应该在声明时**初始化**，否则会出现错误。
content.text_html:
Any variable declared with the auto keyword should be initialized at the time of its declaration or there will be an error.

任何用auto关键字声明的变量都应该在其声明时**初始化，否则会出现错误。
